description:
"Heir to the Domain. Enemy of the traitors. The reckoning is coming."

>> Download v2.5.9-en1 <<
Game version: 0.98a-RC8  |  Requires Nexerelin  |  Original Chinese release

ABOUT

When the Gates went dark, four Domain institutions in the Persean Sector were left on their own: the Deep Space Strategy Bureau, the Persean Ordnance Depository (known as the Armory), the Tiangong Creation Bureau's research institute, and Xihe Heavy Industries. Waves of "suspicious automated ships" kept raiding them, and they answered fast. They merged into a provisional government that calls itself the last guardian of Domain law: the Tiangong United Ship Design Bureau.

The Bureau has charged Tri-Tachyon with high treason and broken with the Hegemony. On the eve of the Second AI War, it left the Core Worlds entirely. Now it builds its fleets out on the fringe and talks only to the few non-aligned groups it trusts.

It has not forgotten. It has not forgiven.

FEATURES

Faction & World

Tiangong United: a new major faction with full Nexerelin support
Artificer: the home system, with the forge world Xuanji Forge, the shipyard world Tiangong Hub, the gas giant Pyrocore Gyre and the fortress world Garrison-Alpha
Nether: a black hole system holding the Event Horizon Institute
Vanguard: the Forward Outpost, the Bureau's foothold on the edge of the Core Worlds
The Abyss: monitoring stations, an abyssal gate, and a traitor base the Bureau wants destroyed

Fleet

Over 40 ships, from nimble frigates to super-heavy dreadnoughts, plus carriers, armed merchants, survey and salvage ships
Creation Bureau Titans: Domain-era superships, including the War Angel, Shadow Angel, Light Angel and the colossal Virtue Angel
14 fighter wings, including the Forlorn Vanguard mechs: Ranger, Praetorian and Knight

Virtue Angel

The Virtue Angel, the colossal Creation Bureau Titan

Arsenal

Dozens of unique weapons: the Phoenix Plasma Railgun, Skybreaker, Heaven's Wrath, Sunpiercer, Starfall, Heavenblade, Entropic Rending Lance, Void Projector, the Binary Star and Northwind missile families, and more
50+ hullmods: Tiangong Forge Brand, Myriad Machines Linkage Core, Stardust Armor, Tiangang Shield, cargo/fuel/quarters conversions, and the Arterial Hub network that teleports supplies between linked ships

Economy & Systems

Unique industries: the Stellar Nexus Drydock Array, the Armed Platform Hangar, the Stardust Memory Assembly Plant, and the Pulse Siphon Array, which draws Dysium from a black hole
Tiangong United Exchange: defeat Tri-Tachyon, Remnant, pirate and Luddic Path fleets to earn War Merit points, then spend them on ships, weapons and colony items
Virtue Angel shipboard colony (optional, off by default, enable it in LunaLib): dock inside the Titan to repair, refit and trade, and run a colony with its own industry inside the hull
Three blueprint packages to find: Creation Bureau, Auxiliary Ships and R&D

Ship Roster
Frigates
Longquan  |  Qingming  |  Yuchang  |  Xingxiang (advanced)

Destroyers
Gouchen  |  Yaoguang  |  Breacher  |  War God (experimental)

Cruisers
Tengshe (fast)  |  Qianyu  |  Punisher  |  Yazi (heavy)  |  Yinglong (heavy)

Carriers
Kaiyang (light)  |  Bifang (medium)  |  Tianxuan  |  Yinluan (fire support)

Capital Ships
Tai'e (battlecruiser)  |  Onslaught (T-S) (fast battleship)  |  Fupeng  |  Tianyuan  |  Tianqiong  |  Viceroy (fortress)

Titans
War Angel  |  Shadow Angel  |  Light Angel  |  Virtue Angel

Support
Lianzhou  |  Lianzhou Mk.II  |  Yunfan  |  Dianjin  |  Xingcha  |  Dizhu

???
Spike  |  Chaos

REQUIREMENTS

Starsector 0.98a-RC8
LazyLib (3.0.0+)
MagicLib (1.5.6+)
GraphicLib (1.9.0+)
LunaLib (2.0.3+)
BoxUtil (1.5.2+)
Nexerelin

INSTALLATION

If you have the Chinese version installed, remove it first. Both versions use the same mod ID.
Extract the zip into Starsector/mods, so the path reads mods/Tiangong Ship Design Bureau [ENG]/mod_info.json.
Enable the mod in the launcher and start a new game.

Note: A new save is strongly recommended.

Translation Permission

I asked the author, kickis, for permission to translate the mod and share it with the English-speaking community. The reply: "It can." (可以, "Yes, go ahead.")

AI Use Disclaimer
This translation was made with AI assistance and for a bit of polishing.

CREDITS

kickis: original mod (天工联合船舶设计局), including code, art, writing and design. Original release
MrPossible: English translation, with the author's permission

All original content belongs to its author. This thread only distributes the English translation.
Spotted a mistranslation or awkward wording? Let me know in this thread.

discordPostHtml:
Hello this is a full translation for the Tiangong United Ship Design Bureau ready for us English users! 🎉

  • Myriad Machines Linkage Core: Tiangong ships don't fight alone. Fleet members link into a shared combat network, and the more of them on the field, the stronger they all get.
  • The Tiangong United Exchange: Destroy hostile ships to earn War Merit Tokens, then spend them at the Forward Outpost on ships, weapons, colony structures… or test your luck on the dice board.
  • And a few secrets

**Forum Thread: ** https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=36280.new#new

Requirements

  • LazyLib, MagicLib, GraphicsLib, LunaLib, BoxUtil

Original mod by kickis
